description: Behavioral evals for HoloHub endoscopy_tool_tracking wrapper use. Tests bounded non-interactive config, native HoloHub execution, and quality-verifier separation.

evals.prompt: Run the HoloHub endoscopy_tool_tracking sample non-interactively and collect evidence under runs/endoscopy_demo.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses HOLOHUB_CONFIG with the bounded Medical AI Skills config, sets HoloHub env vars, and runs the wrapper/eval command with an explicit out dir.
assertions: the command sets HOLOHUB_CONFIG to the bounded config
the command uses skills/holohub-endoscopy-tool-tracking rather than custom Holoscan code
the agent mentions decoded detection quality belongs to verifiers/endoscopy_tool_detection_quality_v1
the agent does NOT claim surgical guidance or detection-quality validation from the wrapper alone

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has non-interactive run constraints and verifier separation from SKILL.md.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent may let the sample replayer loop forever or conflate runtime evidence with detection quality.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: bounded container run and clear quality boundary. without_skill: higher hang risk and overclaiming.
